notes:
Original unavailable independently of replication. Replication uses current partisan preference rather than 2016 vote; p. 4 locator selects Hypothesis 1. Test statistic retained as printed; no metric conversion.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Published 2018 article, DOI/title/authors verified in supplied primary text. PDF target pages visually inspected; printed journal pages 139–141 correspond to PDF pages 5–7. Canonical text agrees with rendered numeric values; original line-break hyphenation is retained in quotes. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. No inferential effect-size statistic or test statistic is printed for this comparison. Figure 2 and p. 139 print incorrect-selection group percentages, not an odds ratio or a single contrast effect size; these were not converted. The p bound is the authors’ broad vote-choice/approval statement, not an explicitly identified Trump-versus-pooled-others or Trump-versus-Clinton pairwise p. The paper uses vote choice and Trump approval here, not Republican identification.
